turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and when?
You're welcome to my time, Hale, but I asked you a question. I'm waiting.
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't manage me, Hale. If his reading level is years ahead, then explain the zero. What do you actually have?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Save the compliments, Hale. I have twenty minutes and you've used three of them telling me nothing. Show me something about Owen's essay, or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.

You want my blessing to "handle this my way" when your way was a zero on his phone before anyone called me. You don't get my trust by asking for it, Hale. Either you have evidence, or that zero comes off today and I want an apology.
